# BoredMutant, full site content

> BoredMutant builds department software, workflow automations, AI agents and company brains for firms of 50 to 500 people, on top of the systems they already run. Based in Hyderabad, India; works with firms in the US, UK and India.

## BoredMutant

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/

**Q: What does the Workflow Sprint cost, and what do we get?**

A: It starts at $1,500 and runs for two weeks. You get a map of one workflow or department with time and error rates measured, a working prototype tested on your own data, and a fixed quote for the full build. If the workflow isn't a good fit for agents, we tell you during the sprint.

**Q: Do you use our data to train AI models?**

A: No. We use model providers' business APIs, whose terms exclude training on customer data, and we never put your data into consumer chat tools. Your data is used only to run your workflow.

**Q: Which systems do you work with?**

A: Usually the ones you already have: email, your CRM or ERP, accounting and practice software, shared drives and spreadsheets. If a system has an API or a reliable export, we can usually work with it. We confirm this during the sprint, before you commit to a build.

**Q: Will you replace our ERP or accounting system?**

A: No. We build around it. Your ERP or accounting software stays the system of record, and the department software and agents we build read from it and write back to it.

**Q: What is a company brain?**

A: A private assistant that answers questions from your documents, email and systems, with links to the sources. It respects existing permissions, so people only see answers drawn from what they can already access. Over time it becomes the shared memory your agents and workflows use.

**Q: What happens when the agent gets something wrong?**

A: Nothing goes out without a person approving it, and every value links back to its source, so mistakes are caught at review. Corrections are logged and used to improve the workflow.

**Q: Who owns what you build?**

A: You do: the code, prompts, configuration and data. If you stop working with us, we hand everything over and delete our copies of your data.

**Q: How is the work priced after launch?**

A: The build is a fixed price, quoted at the end of the sprint. After launch, a monthly fee covers running, monitoring and changes. Once volumes are steady, we can price per result instead, such as per quote or per document.

**Q: Where are you based?**

A: In Hyderabad, India. We work with firms in the US, UK and India, and schedule calls in your time zone.

Where we work Firms with 50 to 500 people and no in-house engineering team, where skilled staff spend hours a week moving information between inboxes, spreadsheets and systems.

Professional services Client intake, engagement letters, document requests and billing follow-up for accounting, legal, engineering and consulting firms.

Finance and insurance Quote comparisons, policy and loan document checks, and renewal follow-up for agencies, brokers and lenders.

Real estate Lease abstraction, maintenance triage and lead follow-up for brokerages and property managers.

Healthcare administration Intake paperwork, scheduling, staff onboarding and billing follow-up for clinics and billing companies. Administrative work only.

Manufacturing and distribution RFQ to quote, order entry from email and PDF, and supplier follow-up for manufacturers and wholesale distributors. Not on the list? If your team spends its week reading, retyping and chasing, the workflow review is a good place to find out whether it fits.

Built to be checked Agents make mistakes. The way to use them safely is to make every output easy to review and every action easy to trace.

A person approves every output Nothing is sent, filed or changed until someone on your team approves it. You decide later which steps, if any, can run on their own.

Every answer shows its source Each drafted value links back to the line of the email, document or record it came from, so review takes seconds, not a re-read.

Exceptions go to a person When something doesn't match your rules, such as terms, prices or expiry dates, the agent flags it instead of guessing.

Your data stays yours NDA and data-processing terms come before any data. We use model providers' business APIs, which don't train on your data, and delete our copies when we finish.

Least access, fully logged Agents get only the permissions the work needs, with their own credentials you can revoke. The company brain shows each person only what they can already see. Every action is logged.

You own what we build The code, prompts, configuration and data are yours. If we stop working together, we hand everything over. Read how we handle security and data

Questions buyers ask

Bring one workflow or department. We'll map it with you. On the call we walk through how the work happens today, what it costs your team in hours, and whether software or an agent can take it over. You leave with a clear yes or no. Book a workflow review Or email pranith@boredmutant.com

## How an engagement works

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/how-it-works

Home / How it works

How an engagement works We take one workflow or department at a time. You see a prototype working on your own examples before you commit to a build, and every output is approved by your team once it runs.

1. Workflow Sprint 2 weeks From $1,500 The sprint answers one question with evidence: is this worth building, and should it be software, an automation or an agent? Week 1: map and measure. We sit with the people who do the work, walk through 20 to 30 real examples, and record each step, the systems involved, time per item and how often things go wrong. Week 2: prototype on your data. We build a working prototype and run it on examples it hasn't seen. You see where it is right, where it is wrong and why.

What you get A map of the workflow, with today's hours and error rate A working prototype and a recorded walkthrough of it on your examples A fixed price and timeline for the full build A plain recommendation, including "don't build this" when that's the answer

What we need from you One person who owns the workflow, for about two hours a week 20 to 30 real examples, anonymized if you prefer Read-only access or exports from the systems involved

2. Build and launch 3 to 6 weeks, fixed price quoted after the sprint Connect. We connect the agent to your systems with its own credentials and only the permissions the workflow needs. Build the review step. Every output lands as a draft with its sources linked and exceptions flagged, wherever your team already works. Test on unseen cases. We hold back real examples and measure accuracy on them before anyone relies on the agent. Run side by side. For about a week the agent drafts while your team works as usual, so you can compare before go-live. Go live. Your team approves drafts instead of producing them. We train the people involved and document the workflow.

3. Run and improve Monthly Monitoring. We watch every run, and failures alert us before they reach your team. A monthly report. Volume handled, time saved, corrections made and what changed. Changes as you change. New price lists, new document types and new rules are part of the monthly fee. Per-result pricing. Once volumes are steady, you can pay per quote, document or ticket instead of a flat fee. You can stop at any point. The code, prompts, configuration and data are yours, and we hand them over.

Start with one workflow review. Tell us which work your team keeps retyping. We'll tell you whether a sprint makes sense, and what it would cost. Book a workflow review Or email pranith@boredmutant.com

## Security and data handling

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/security

Home / Security

How we handle your data and access Agents that touch your inbox, CRM or documents need clear limits. Here is what we do on every engagement, and what we don't yet have.

Agreements first We sign an NDA before any discovery call that involves your data. We sign data-processing terms before we receive any examples or system access. We're happy to use yours. We complete your security questionnaire as part of the sprint.

Access Each agent gets its own credentials, never a person's login. Permissions are limited to what the workflow needs. Read-only wherever the workflow allows. You can revoke access at any time from your own admin settings. Every action an agent takes is logged with the input it used and the person who approved it.

Data and models Your data is used only to run your workflow. We use model providers' business APIs, whose terms exclude training on customer data. We never put your data into consumer chat tools. We keep only what the workflow needs, for as long as it needs it, and delete our copies when the engagement ends. We choose models per workflow, and the system is built so models can be swapped without a rebuild.

Human review Every output starts as a draft that a named person on your team approves. Each drafted value links to its source, and anything that breaks your rules is flagged for a person. Any move to automatic approval is your decision, made one step at a time, based on measured accuracy.

What we don't have yet We're a small studio. We don't hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification. Instead, we work under your policies and agreements, answer your security questionnaire in full, and keep our scope narrow. Patient health records and payment card data are out of scope unless the right agreements are in place first. In healthcare we work on administrative workflows only. Questions about a specific requirement? Email pranith@boredmutant.com and we'll answer in writing.

Talk it through on a workflow review. Bring your security team if you like. We'll cover access, data flow and approvals for the workflow you have in mind. Book a workflow review

## About BoredMutant

URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/about

Home / About

The software team for companies without one BoredMutant builds custom software, workflow automations, AI agents and company brains for firms that run on spreadsheets, email and too many SaaS tools. We're a technology company registered in India, based in Hyderabad.

Who you work with BoredMutant is founder-led. The person who maps your workflow is the person who designs and builds it, so nothing gets lost in a handoff. We work with firms of 50 to 500 people in the US, UK and India, and schedule calls in your time zone.

How we work

One workflow at a time We'd rather make one workflow or department run reliably than start five half-finished projects.

Measured before and after We record hours and error rates before we build, so the results are numbers, not impressions.

People stay in charge Agents draft. Your team approves. Automation grows only as fast as the accuracy you've seen.

We say when it isn't a fit Some work needs judgment that agents can't supply yet. When that's the case, we'll tell you in the sprint, not after the build.

Contact Book a workflow review pranith@boredmutant.com Hyderabad, India
